claims.value: Laguna S 2.1 is a 118B total parameter Mixture-of-Experts model with 8B activated parameters per token, designed for agentic coding and long-horizon work. Features include a token-choice router with softplus gating over 256 routed experts plus one shared expert, grouped-query attention, and interleaved full/sliding-window attention with a 1,048,576-token context window. It supports native reasoning via the `enable_thinking` parameter and tool calls.
claims.evidence: Laguna S 2.1 is a 118B total parameter Mixture-of-Experts model with 8B activated parameters per token
